skill.name: Radiant Blast
skill.description: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.

skill.name: Ground Slam
skill.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

skill.name: Unstoppable Force
skill.description: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

skill.name: Consume
skill.description: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.
